title: Unraveling the Allosteric Mechanism and Mechanical Stability of Partial and Complete Loss-of-Function Mutations in p53 DNA-Binding Domain
authors: Han Zhou; Tao Zhou; Shiwei Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究p53 DNA结合域突变对二聚体-DNA复合物结构、变构机制及机械稳定性的影响，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配课题。
abstract: TP53 is the most frequently mutated tumor suppressor gene in human cancers, with mutations primarily in its DNA-binding domain (p53-DBD). Mutations in p53-DBD are categorized into hotspot mutations (resulting in complete loss-of-function) and non-hotspot mutations (inducing partial loss-of-function). However, the allosteric mechanisms underlying non-hotspot mutations remain elusive. Using p53 dimer as models, we constructed p53-WT, non-hotspot p53-E180R, and hotspot p53-R248W dimer-DNA complexes to compare the structural and functional impacts of these two mutation types. Our results reveal that both mutations weaken intramolecular interactions in p53-DBD and enhance structural flexibility. Specifically, E180R perturbs dimer interface interactions, impairing dimer stability and cooperative DNA binding; R248W disrupts interactions between the L3/L1 loops and DNA, leading to the loss of DNA-binding capacity. Steered molecular dynamics (SMD) simulations further confirm that both mutations accelerate p53 dimer dissociation, with E180R exerting the most prominent disruptive effect on the mechanical stability of the dimer interface.
abstract_zh: TP53是人类癌症中最常发生突变的肿瘤抑制基因，其突变主要位于DNA结合域（p53-DBD）。p53-DBD的突变分为热点突变（导致完全功能丧失）和非热点突变（引起部分功能丧失）。然而，非热点突变背后的变构机制仍不清楚。以p53二聚体为模型，我们构建了p53-WT、非热点p53-E180R和热点p53-R248W二聚体-DNA复合物，以比较这两种突变类型在结构和功能上的影响。我们的结果表明，两种突变均削弱了p53-DBD中的分子内相互作用，并增强了结构灵活性。具体而言，E180R扰动了二聚体界面相互作用，损害了二聚体稳定性和协同DNA结合；R248W破坏了L3/L1环与DNA之间的相互作用，导致DNA结合能力丧失。拉伸分子动力学（SMD）模拟进一步证实，两种突变均加速了p53二聚体解离，其中E180R对二聚体界面机械稳定性的破坏作用最为显著。
